label: explicit keyspace mapping
type: an administrator-specified mapping from a source scope or collection to a differently-named target one, required whenever names differ - and required by collection filtering, which cannot be expressed without it.
evidence: An _explicit_ mapping between collections is one established by an administrator, so as to allow replication between differently-named keyspaces.

note: The filtering dependency is the fact worth having in the registry: filter-xdcr-replication.md needs an explicit mapping in order to filter at collection granularity, which means a reader who only learns about mappings from the mapping page will not know that choosing to filter forces the choice of mapping mode.
